review.why: Interviews the user to build a bank of real, evidenced achievements before any resume writing.
review.summary: Asks two or three questions at a time to recover what the user actually did, then fills one card per achievement (context, action, evidence, outcome, measurement, disclosure, relevance, open questions). Unknown numbers stay unknown and nothing is borrowed from industry averages.
strengths: Fills the gap before resume writing: people who cannot recall their wins
Honest handling of metrics, including percentage versus percentage points
Does not demand confidential uploads; redacted aggregates are enough
cautions: Instructions only: no template file for the cards
Describes saving facts to a Reactive Resume account through a named tool
Stops at the evidence bank; resume writing is left to other skills
